component.name: @APP_NAME@
component.summary: Watch films and series from your Stremio add-ons

description.p: A player and add-on client: browse the catalogs of your Stremio add-ons, pick a stream and watch it, with a built-in torrent engine or through your debrid service.
The app contains no media and hosts no streams. Add-ons are run by third parties, and you are responsible for what you watch.
